reference.text: Count from one to ten at an easy pace, in your everyday voice.
reference.source_note: Counting is an automatic-speech task listed in the NHS Fife progression activities. Lilt uses the same prompt every time so recordings stay comparable.

questions: What did you do this morning?
What would you like to eat later, and why?
Describe the room you are in right now.
What is something you are looking forward to this week?
Tell me about a place you like to go.
spontaneous.source_note: Answering a question is the NHS Fife example of speech that needs you to think about what you say.
